No specialist hiring, job tools, worker permissions, provider calls or real transactions.
No claim that the remaining catalogue directions or profession-specific workstation variants are complete.

conventions.coordinates: Godot 2D screen/world convention: +x east/right, +y south/down; north=[0,-1], east=[1,0], south=[0,1], west=[-1,0].
conventions.facing: Workstations and host-attached role kits use operator gaze. Seating uses occupant gaze; multi-seat tables retain a reference-seat gaze, not an exclusive front. Shared service families explicitly use service_side N/E/S/W with opposite approach_gaze. Visual-orientation-only props have no fabricated service action. Direction semantics are declared per family.
conventions.projection: Use the existing cozy overhead/front-elevation game projection and original Startup Valley silhouettes, never isometric room rendering.
conventions.floor_anchor: All four views retain one family canvas and the identical floor_anchor_px, representing local floor pivot [0,0]. Layers share that canvas and anchor; occupied cells rotate about this pivot. Do not crop each view to a different origin or scale it to fit.
conventions.footprint: Base masks are explicitly proposed per direction. East/west swap the north/south width and depth. Rotating logical masks is permitted; rotating the raster is not. Decor kits add no occupied cells and inherit host clearance.
conventions.footprint_migration: Legacy masks remain recorded in current_availability. Coffee/archive/approval service South proposals preserve existing masks and interaction cells exactly; other proposal-to-runtime differences are not migrated automatically. Runtime integration still must validate collisions, work/interaction cells and visual-wall clearance.
conventions.interaction: Service-family proposed masks and approach cells are reindexed from the opposite old gaze slot, preserving fixed-pivot rotation and each legacy South service binding. Workstation/seating/reference-seat conventions remain unchanged. Planned cells do not imply an implemented interaction or accepted pose.
conventions.native_pixels: Export PNG RGBA with real transparency at the declared native envelope, nearest filtering and unit runtime scale. Padding belongs to the envelope; do not upscale furniture to fill it. Match the founder/Mina/Theo 48x80 native actors and 32px floor cells.
conventions.art_direction: Warm restrained wood, pale paper/fabric and charcoal tech, using the current Startup Valley assets as references. Keep tools readable and low clutter; no copied Stardew characters, logos or furniture.

palette.material_ramps: Sample existing approved Startup Valley wood/shadow ramps; accents are restrained, not a requirement to place every brand color on each object.

conventions.lighting: One shared upper-left light convention. North, east, south and west are separately drawn projections with consistent material and proportion; fronts, backs, monitor backs, handles and drawer faces must make physical sense.
conventions.base_vs_decor: Bases own structure, floor shadow, collision and seat/front occlusion. Decor kits own detachable role tools only: no desk, chair, worker, floor, walls, baked shadow for the whole base or collision footprint.
conventions.overlays: Optional ambient overlays may be drawn but remain separate from static equipment. Their runtime timing and connection to real events are future integration work.
conventions.availability: Seven historical legacy South references remain recorded. The archive, decision console, prototype bench, and shared workstation base components (desk, ergonomic chair, shared computer kit) have four reviewed runtime-integrated directions. Collaboration-cluster-v2 now has complete four-facing native-review evidence, but remains unapproved and unregistered while collaboration-table-v1 and the default South placement stay active.
acceptance_gates: True alpha with no baked checkerboard, wall, floor, text, actor or neighboring prop.
Native silhouette and palette review beside a48x80 actor at100%, not only a contact sheet.
All required layers and directions align on the shared floor pivot; seat/front occlusion demonstrated where relevant.
Facing and physical details are actual redraws; N/E footprint dimensions rotate consistently.
Occupied, approach and visual-clearance regions are separately validated against walls, doors and circulation.
Same-art family identity across all four directions; no arbitrary per-direction scale, perspective or anchor drift.
Store real file and native evidence paths only after those files exist; runtime_integrated requires separate implementation and tests.

layer_contract.floor_shadow: Ground-only shadow; shared origin, no body or baked floor.
layer_contract.rear_structure: Back legs, far-side body and supports behind the actor; not an arbitrary fixed z-index across directions.
layer_contract.seat_back: Backrest/back seat parts that belong behind a seated actor.
layer_contract.seat_front: Near chair seat/legs that occlude only the correct lower-body region.
layer_contract.front_structure: Near edge, apron, doors or glass front drawn above the appropriate actor pixels.
layer_contract.surface_decor_rear: Role/computer equipment behind the actor or hands at the host's authored socket.
layer_contract.surface_decor_front: Near-side detachable objects that require front occlusion.
layer_contract.ambient_overlay: Optional independent steam, scan, screen or light animation; no actor or solid structure.
layer_contract.actor: Never included in furniture or kit export; use a temporary48x80 placement silhouette only in review evidence.
layer_contract.per_facing_order: Preserve semantic separation, then validate direction-specific draw order. Do not reuse south-facing z offsets blindly for east/north/west.
layer_contract.top_surface: Solid cabinet roof: fixed screen-axis material and shared whole-cabinet depth, not a shadow.
layer_contract.base_plinth: Solid bottom plinth at floor contact; not a ground shadow.
layer_contract.ground_base: Physical floor rails, feet or caster assemblies; not a cast floor shadow.
layer_contract.counter_carcass: Coffee-station counter body beneath the fixed top; same registered canvas and solid-body depth.
layer_contract.counter_top: Coffee-station fixed-axis worktop; independently exported rather than rotated with a finished view.
layer_contract.counter_front: Coffee-station near face and doors; direction-specific pixels on the shared solid-body depth.
layer_contract.counter_plinth: Coffee-station solid floor-contact plinth; not a cast shadow.
layer_contract.service_panel: Direction-specific coffee-station rear, control, reservoir or vent face; not an interaction promise.
layer_contract.espresso: Independently authored espresso-machine volume on the registered counter support.
layer_contract.grinder: Independently authored grinder volume in the per-side contact order.
layer_contract.serviceware: Independent two-mug serviceware cluster; visual detail only.
layer_contract.plant: Independent coffee-station plant layer; visual detail only.
layer_contract.tool_overlay: Direction-specific research instrument display and samples on the registered bench support.
layer_contract.interior: Independently reusable interior floor, lining and shelf behind a closed furniture shell; does not imply an enterable room or actor behavior.
layer_contract.door_glazing: Detachable clear glazing edge/reflection and door fittings; binary alpha, no checkerboard, direction-specific shell occlusion.
